inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Top 10 Most Sprayed UPNs by IPs and Countries using BehaviourAnalytics

properties.description:
This rule identifies user accounts (UPNs) that are the top targets of password spraying / brute force login attempts over the last 7 days.

It leverages the BehaviorAnalytics table in Microsoft Sentinel, focusing on failed login activities from Azure AD that are correlated with threat intelligence indicators such as Bruteforce, Botnet, or Watchlist hits.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Top 10 Most Sprayed UPNs by IPs and Countries using BehaviourAnalytics
properties.query:
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
| where ActivityType == "FailedLogOn" and EventSource == "Azure AD"
| where DevicesInsights has "ThreatIntelIndicatorType"
| extend ParsedJson = parse_json(ActivityInsights)
| extend 
    ActionUncommonlyPerformedByUser = tostring(ParsedJson.ActionUncommonlyPerformedByUser),
    App = tostring(ParsedJson.App),
    Resource = tostring(ParsedJson.Resource),
    UncommonHighVolumeOfActions = tostring(ParsedJson.UncommonHighVolumeOfActions),
    UnusualNumberOfFailedSignInOfThisUser = tostring(ParsedJson.UnusualNumberOfFailedSignInOfThisUser),
    UnusualNumberOfDistinctUsersFailedSignInFromIPAddress = tostring(ParsedJson.UnusualNumberOfDistinctUsersFailedSignInFromIPAddress)
| project-away ParsedJson
| where UnusualNumberOfFailedSignInOfThisUser <> "False" or ActionUncommonlyPerformedByUser <> "False"
| extend ThreatType = tostring(DevicesInsights.ThreatIntelIndicatorType)
| where InvestigationPriority > 0
| where ThreatType has "Bruteforce"
    or ThreatType has "Botnet"
    or ThreatType has "Watchlist"
| summarize
    SourceIPAdderss = make_set(SourceIPAddress, 100),
    SourceLocation = make_set(SourceIPLocation, 100),
    NumofIPAttack=dcount(SourceIPAddress),
    NumofCountryAttack=dcount(SourceIPLocation)
    by UserPrincipalName
| top 10 by NumofIPAttack desc
